one_liner: Compiles real on-chain activity for a watched address over a 7-day block window — transaction count, volume in and out, gas spent — diffed against the previous period.
what_it_does: This lamp watches one address for a full week and writes a plain-language summary of everything it did on-chain. It reads every transaction in the 7-day block window — count, volume in and out, gas spent — and diffs the totals against the previous week. Proven by 110 real transactions compiled from 7 days of Atlantic testnet blocks.
